rules.invariant: Cross-owner callers only use declared public interfaces.
rules.failure_story: A caller can bind to an implementation detail that changes without its contract, causing a hidden runtime break after relocation.
rules.next_action: replace the private import with the owning public interface

rules.invariant: Provider clients initialize only after an authorized provider operation reaches its adapter boundary.
rules.failure_story: A status or help command can load credentials or provider transport before authorization, violating dry-run and human-control boundaries.
rules.next_action: move the provider import behind the adapter operation boundary

rules.invariant: Framework tests never treat deck_* or dpt_* production data as fixtures.
rules.failure_story: A regression test can mutate or encode a real production bundle, making tests non-reproducible and risking user data.
rules.next_action: replace the production-data fixture with a temporary synthetic fixture

rules.invariant: One exact run version has one Page Authority state and evidence graph.
rules.failure_story: Conflicting records could select a different authorization or delivery lineage for the same version.
rules.next_action: run the state owner's Page Authority repair checkpoint without hand-editing records
